title: VerificationOutcome
description: Comparison of a simulated fee figure against observed real-position data (FR-008, FR-009, FR-010). null fields encode could-not-verify rather than a silent pass.

simulatedFeesUsd.description: Simulator's fee figure for the matched configuration.

absDiffUsd.description: |simulated - observed|. null when observed is null.

relDiff.description: absDiff / max(observed, epsilon). null when observed is null.

status.description: pass iff relDiff <= tolerance; could_not_verify if observed missing/insufficient data.

note.description: Human-readable direction and magnitude of any breach, or the reason verification could not be performed.

position.description: The observed position reconciled against, when available.
